queries.result: Dehradun District Administration links the official Bhulekh service for viewing land records and directs signed RoR requests to the concerned tehsil land-record computer centre. Uttarakhand’s registration GIS portal describes property-transaction geoservices, but its citizen portal page exposed no parcel layer or public vector schema. No map-backed parcel response was verified at the WUP point.

registryBasis: The district administration identifies the Board of Revenue in Dehradun and local tehsil land-record computer centres; it confirms city/district land-record activity but not public parcel geometry at the WUP point.
technicalBlocker: The official district land-record page links Bhulekh for view-only records; its linked page timed out through the anonymous reader. The state registration GIS citizen portal is a dynamic shell and exposes no parcel-vector schema in the inspected public page.
remainingUncertainty: The district page and DILRMP dashboard do not establish whether the exact WUP point has a digitized urban parcel map; completeness and exact point coverage remain unverified.
nextStep: Recheck if the official local provider exposes an anonymous safe-ID parcel-vector layer or point-to-feature schema.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
